```{r survival_curves_by_ctdna_tertiles}
# Create tertiles of ctDNA
if (nrow(outcomes) >= 3) {
  outcomes_tertiles <- outcomes %>%
    mutate(
      mfs_time_months = mfs_time / 30.44,
      ctdna_tertile = ntile(ctdna_before_line_value, 3),
      ctdna_tertile_label = case_when(
        ctdna_tertile == 1 ~ "T1 (Lowest)",
        ctdna_tertile == 2 ~ "T2",
        ctdna_tertile == 3 ~ "T3 (Highest)"
      )
    )
  
  # Check if we have enough events per tertile
  events_per_tertile <- outcomes_tertiles %>%
    group_by(ctdna_tertile_label) %>%
    summarise(n_events = sum(mfs_event, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  if (all(events_per_tertile$n_events > 0) && nrow(events_per_tertile) > 1) {
    # Fit survival curves (months)
    surv_fit <- survfit(Surv(mfs_time_months, mfs_event) ~ ctdna_tertile_label, data = outcomes_tertiles)
    
    # Plot with 95% confidence intervals
    p <- ggsurvplot(
      surv_fit,
      data = outcomes_tertiles,
      pval = TRUE,
      conf.int = TRUE,
      conf.int.style = "ribbon",
      risk.table = TRUE,
      xlab = "Time (months)",
      ylab = "Duration of Complete Response Probability",
      title = "Duration of Complete Response by ctDNA Tertile Before Therapy",
      legend.title = "ctDNA Tertile",
      legend.labs = c("T1 (Lowest)", "T2", "T3 (Highest)"),
      xlim = c(0, 36)
    )
    
    p$plot
  } else {
    cat("Insufficient events for tertile analysis. Showing overall DCR curve instead.\n")
    surv_fit_overall <- survfit(Surv(mfs_time / 30.44, mfs_event) ~ 1, data = outcomes)
    p_overall <- ggsurvplot(
      surv_fit_overall,
      data = outcomes,
      conf.int = TRUE,
      xlab = "Time (months)",
      ylab = "Duration of Complete Response Probability",
      title = "Duration of Complete Response",
      xlim = c(0, 36)
    )
    p_overall$plot
  }
} else {
  cat("Insufficient sample size (n < 3) for tertile analysis.\n")
}
```

```{r cox_model_tertiles_comparison, include=FALSE}
# Cox model comparing ctDNA tertiles for DCR
# Note: Tertile comparisons are now included in the main Cox model table above
# This chunk is kept for backward compatibility but results are shown in ctDNA_prognosis_analysis
if (nrow(outcomes) >= 3) {
  # Create tertiles if not already created
  if (!exists("outcomes_tertiles") || nrow(outcomes_tertiles) == 0) {
    outcomes_tertiles <- outcomes %>%
      mutate(
        mfs_time_months = mfs_time / 30.44,
        ctdna_tertile = ntile(ctdna_before_line_value, 3),
        ctdna_tertile_label = case_when(
          ctdna_tertile == 1 ~ "T1 (Lowest)",
          ctdna_tertile == 2 ~ "T2",
          ctdna_tertile == 3 ~ "T3 (Highest)"
        )
      )
  }
  
  if (exists("outcomes_tertiles") && nrow(outcomes_tertiles) >= 3) {
  # Fit Cox model with tertiles as factor (T1 as reference)
  outcomes_tertiles_factor <- outcomes_tertiles %>%
    mutate(
      ctdna_tertile_factor = factor(ctdna_tertile_label, 
                                      levels = c("T1 (Lowest)", "T2", "T3 (Highest)")),
      therapy_line_grouped = case_when(
        therapy_line == 1 ~ "1L",
        therapy_line == 2 ~ "2L",
        therapy_line == 3 ~ "3L",
        therapy_line >= 4 ~ "4L+",
        TRUE ~ as.character(therapy_line)
      ),
      therapy_line_factor = factor(therapy_line_grouped, levels = c("1L", "2L", "3L", "4L+"))
    )
  
  # Unadjusted model
  cox_model_tertiles_unadj <- coxph(Surv(mfs_time, mfs_event) ~ ctdna_tertile_factor, 
                                     data = outcomes_tertiles_factor)
  cox_summary_tertiles_unadj <- summary(cox_model_tertiles_unadj)
  
  # Adjusted model (for line of therapy)
  cox_model_tertiles_adj <- coxph(Surv(mfs_time, mfs_event) ~ ctdna_tertile_factor + therapy_line_factor, 
                                   data = outcomes_tertiles_factor)
  cox_summary_tertiles_adj <- summary(cox_model_tertiles_adj)
  
  # Extract HRs and CIs for each tertile vs T1 (unadjusted)
  hr_t2_unadj <- exp(cox_summary_tertiles_unadj$coefficients[1, "coef"])
  hr_t2_unadj_lower <- cox_summary_tertiles_unadj$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
  hr_t2_unadj_upper <- cox_summary_tertiles_unadj$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
  p_t2_unadj <- cox_summary_tertiles_unadj$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  hr_t3_unadj <- exp(cox_summary_tertiles_unadj$coefficients[2, "coef"])
  hr_t3_unadj_lower <- cox_summary_tertiles_unadj$conf.int[2, "lower .95"]
  hr_t3_unadj_upper <- cox_summary_tertiles_unadj$conf.int[2, "upper .95"]
  p_t3_unadj <- cox_summary_tertiles_unadj$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  # Extract HRs and CIs for each tertile vs T1 (adjusted)
  # Find indices for tertile coefficients (they come after intercept if present)
  tertile_idx_adj <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_summary_tertiles_adj$coefficients), "ctdna_tertile_factor"))
  hr_t2_adj <- exp(cox_summary_tertiles_adj$coefficients[tertile_idx_adj[1], "coef"])
  hr_t2_adj_lower <- cox_summary_tertiles_adj$conf.int[tertile_idx_adj[1], "lower .95"]
  hr_t2_adj_upper <- cox_summary_tertiles_adj$conf.int[tertile_idx_adj[1], "upper .95"]
  p_t2_adj <- cox_summary_tertiles_adj$coefficients[tertile_idx_adj[1], "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  hr_t3_adj <- exp(cox_summary_tertiles_adj$coefficients[tertile_idx_adj[2], "coef"])
  hr_t3_adj_lower <- cox_summary_tertiles_adj$conf.int[tertile_idx_adj[2], "lower .95"]
  hr_t3_adj_upper <- cox_summary_tertiles_adj$conf.int[tertile_idx_adj[2], "upper .95"]
  p_t3_adj <- cox_summary_tertiles_adj$coefficients[tertile_idx_adj[2], "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  # Create comparison table
  tertile_comparisons <- tibble(
    `Comparison` = c("T2 vs T1 (Unadjusted)", "T3 vs T1 (Unadjusted)", 
                      "T2 vs T1 (Adjusted for line of therapy)", "T3 vs T1 (Adjusted for line of therapy)"),
    `HR (95% CI)` = c(
      paste0(round(hr_t2_unadj, 2), " (", round(hr_t2_unadj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_t2_unadj_upper, 2), ")"),
      paste0(round(hr_t3_unadj, 2), " (", round(hr_t3_unadj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_t3_unadj_upper, 2), ")"),
      paste0(round(hr_t2_adj, 2), " (", round(hr_t2_adj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_t2_adj_upper, 2), ")"),
      paste0(round(hr_t3_adj, 2), " (", round(hr_t3_adj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_t3_adj_upper, 2), ")")
    ),
    `P-value` = c(
      ifelse(p_t2_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_t2_unadj, 3))),
      ifelse(p_t3_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_t3_unadj, 3))),
      ifelse(p_t2_adj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_t2_adj, 3))),
      ifelse(p_t3_adj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_t3_adj, 3)))
    )
  )
  
  # Note: Tertile comparisons are now shown in the main Cox model table
  # This section is kept for diagnostic purposes
  cat("Tertile comparisons are included in the main Cox model table above.\n")
  
  # Overall test for trend
  cat("\n**Overall Test for Trend (Unadjusted):**\n")
  overall_p_unadj <- cox_summary_tertiles_unadj$sctest["pvalue"]
  cat("Wald test p-value:", 
      ifelse(overall_p_unadj < 0.001, 
             "<0.001", 
             round(overall_p_unadj, 3)), "\n")
  
  cat("\n**Overall Test for Trend (Adjusted for line of therapy):**\n")
  overall_p_adj <- cox_summary_tertiles_adj$sctest["pvalue"]
  cat("Wald test p-value:", 
      ifelse(overall_p_adj < 0.001, 
             "<0.001", 
             round(overall_p_adj, 3)), "\n")
  
  } else {
    cat("Insufficient data for tertile Cox model comparisons.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Insufficient sample size (n < 3) for tertile Cox model comparisons.\n")
}
```

```{r pairwise_tertile_comparisons}
# Pairwise comparisons between tertiles using Cox models
if (exists("outcomes_tertiles") && nrow(outcomes_tertiles) >= 3) {
  # Fit Cox model with tertiles as factor (T1 as reference)
  outcomes_tertiles_factor <- outcomes_tertiles %>%
    mutate(
      ctdna_tertile_factor = factor(ctdna_tertile_label, 
                                      levels = c("T1 (Lowest)", "T2", "T3 (Highest)"))
    )
  
  cox_model_tertiles <- coxph(Surv(mfs_time, mfs_event) ~ ctdna_tertile_factor, 
                                data = outcomes_tertiles_factor)
  cox_summary_tertiles <- summary(cox_model_tertiles)
  
  # Extract HRs and CIs for each tertile vs T1
  hr_t2 <- exp(cox_summary_tertiles$coefficients[1, "coef"])
  hr_t2_lower <- cox_summary_tertiles$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
  hr_t2_upper <- cox_summary_tertiles$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
  p_t2 <- cox_summary_tertiles$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  hr_t3 <- exp(cox_summary_tertiles$coefficients[2, "coef"])
  hr_t3_lower <- cox_summary_tertiles$conf.int[2, "lower .95"]
  hr_t3_upper <- cox_summary_tertiles$conf.int[2, "upper .95"]
  p_t3 <- cox_summary_tertiles$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  tertile_comparisons <- tibble(
    `Comparison` = c("T2 vs T1", "T3 vs T1"),
    `HR (95% CI)` = c(
      paste0(round(hr_t2, 2), " (", round(hr_t2_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_t2_upper, 2), ")"),
      paste0(round(hr_t3, 2), " (", round(hr_t3_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_t3_upper, 2), ")")
    ),
    `P-value` = c(
      ifelse(p_t2 < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_t2, 3)),
      ifelse(p_t3 < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_t3, 3))
    )
  )
  
  # Also do pairwise log-rank tests
  pairwise_logrank <- tryCatch(
    pairwise_survdiff(Surv(mfs_time, mfs_event) ~ ctdna_tertile_label, 
                      data = outcomes_tertiles),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  # Create pairwise comparison table with log-rank p-values
  if (!is.null(pairwise_logrank) && !is.null(pairwise_logrank$p.value)) {
    pval_matrix <- pairwise_logrank$p.value
    # Extract p-values safely - check matrix dimensions
    n_rows <- nrow(pval_matrix)
    n_cols <- ncol(pval_matrix)
    
    # Get p-values for T2, T3 vs T1 (row 1, columns 2, 3)
    pval_t2 <- if (n_rows >= 1 && n_cols >= 2 && !is.na(pval_matrix[1, 2])) {
      if (pval_matrix[1, 2] < 0.001) "<0.001" else as.character(round(pval_matrix[1, 2], 3))
    } else "N/A"
    pval_t3 <- if (n_rows >= 1 && n_cols >= 3 && !is.na(pval_matrix[1, 3])) {
      if (pval_matrix[1, 3] < 0.001) "<0.001" else as.character(round(pval_matrix[1, 3], 3))
    } else "N/A"
    
    pairwise_table <- tertile_comparisons %>%
      mutate(`Log-rank P-value` = c(pval_t2, pval_t3))
  } else {
    pairwise_table <- tertile_comparisons %>%
      mutate(`Log-rank P-value` = c("N/A", "N/A"))
  }
  
  pairwise_table_display <- pairwise_table %>%
    kable(caption = "Pairwise Comparisons: ctDNA Tertiles vs. T1 (Lowest)") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
  
  pairwise_table_display
  
  # Overall test for trend
  cat("\n**Overall Test for Trend:**\n")
  overall_p <- cox_summary_tertiles$sctest["pvalue"]
  cat("Wald test p-value:", 
      ifelse(overall_p < 0.001, 
             "<0.001", 
             round(overall_p, 3)), "\n")
  
} else {
  cat("Insufficient data for pairwise tertile comparisons.\n")
}
```

```{r sensitivity_analysis_censored_as_events}
# Extract HR and CI for sensitivity analysis

hr_sens_upper <- cox_summary_sensitivity$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
```

## Research Question 2

**What is the association between early on-treatment ctDNA response (cleared vs not cleared) at 6-16 weeks after therapy initiation and subsequent duration of complete response?**

This analysis examines whether early ctDNA clearance (within 6-16 weeks after starting therapy) is associated with improved duration of complete response. The landmark analysis uses the latest ctDNA measurement available within the 6-16 week window to assess clearance status, and analyzes duration of complete response from that landmark time point forward. **Note:** Only alive patients require imaging data for inclusion (to determine complete response status, similar to RECIST CR). Patients who died do NOT require imaging data (death is an event).

```{r landmark_analysis_early_response, include=FALSE}
# ====================================================================================
# LANDMARK ANALYSIS: Early On-Treatment ctDNA Response
# ====================================================================================
# This analysis examines the significance of early on-treatment ctDNA response
# at a landmark time point (e.g., 6-12 weeks after therapy start)
# 
# Approach:
# 1. For each patient-line observation, find ctDNA before therapy (baseline)
# 2. Find LATEST on-treatment ctDNA within landmark window (6-16 weeks) for response assessment
# 3. Determine clearance status (binary: cleared vs not cleared) at landmark time
# 4. Perform landmark analysis: only include patients who survived to landmark
# 5. Compare survival from landmark time point between cleared and not cleared groups
# ====================================================================================

# Define landmark window: 6-16 weeks after therapy start
landmark_window_start_weeks <- 6
landmark_window_end_weeks <- 16
landmark_window_start_days <- landmark_window_start_weeks * 7
landmark_window_end_days <- landmark_window_end_weeks * 7

# For each patient-line observation, get baseline ctDNA (already have this from universe)
# and find on-treatment ctDNA within landmark window
landmark_data <- outcomes %>%
  select(patient_id, therapy_line, time_zero_date, ctdna_before_line_date, 
         ctdna_before_line_value, mfs_time, mfs_event) %>%
  # Get on-treatment ctDNA measurements
  left_join(
    ctdna_long %>%
      select(patient_id, ctdna_date, ctdna_value),
    by = "patient_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate days from therapy start to on-treatment ctDNA
    days_from_therapy_start = as.numeric(ctdna_date - time_zero_date),
    # Check if on-treatment ctDNA is within landmark window (6-16 weeks)
    in_landmark_window = days_from_therapy_start >= landmark_window_start_days & 
                         days_from_therapy_start <= landmark_window_end_days
  ) %>%
  filter(in_landmark_window) %>%
  # For each patient-line, take the LATEST on-treatment ctDNA in the window (for response assessment)
  arrange(patient_id, therapy_line, desc(days_from_therapy_start)) %>%
  group_by(patient_id, therapy_line) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate % decline from baseline
    baseline_ctdna = ctdna_before_line_value,
    on_tx_ctdna = ctdna_value,
    # % decline = (baseline - on_tx) / baseline * 100
    # Handle case where baseline = 0 (use absolute change instead)
    pct_decline = case_when(
      baseline_ctdna > 0 ~ ((baseline_ctdna - on_tx_ctdna) / baseline_ctdna) * 100,
      baseline_ctdna == 0 & on_tx_ctdna == 0 ~ 0,  # Both 0 = no change
      baseline_ctdna == 0 & on_tx_ctdna > 0 ~ -Inf,  # New positive = increase
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    # Binary clearance: ctDNA cleared at landmark time (on_tx = 0 and baseline > 0)
    ctdna_cleared_at_landmark = case_when(
      baseline_ctdna > 0 & on_tx_ctdna == 0 ~ TRUE,
      baseline_ctdna > 0 & on_tx_ctdna > 0 ~ FALSE,
      baseline_ctdna == 0 ~ NA,  # Can't clear if already negative
      TRUE ~ NA
    ),
    # Response categories based on % decline
    response_category = case_when(
      ctdna_cleared_at_landmark == TRUE ~ "Cleared (100% decline)",
      pct_decline >= 50 ~ "Major Response (≥50% decline)",
      pct_decline >= 0 & pct_decline < 50 ~ "Minor Response (0-50% decline)",
      pct_decline < 0 ~ "Progression (increase)",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    # Landmark time point: use the actual ctDNA measurement time within 6-16 weeks
    landmark_time = days_from_therapy_start
  ) %>%
  select(patient_id, therapy_line, time_zero_date, landmark_time,
         baseline_ctdna, on_tx_ctdna, pct_decline, ctdna_cleared_at_landmark, response_category)

# Now perform landmark analysis: only include patients who survived to landmark
# and calculate survival from landmark time point
landmark_outcomes <- landmark_data %>%
  left_join(
    outcomes %>% 
      select(patient_id, therapy_line, mfs_time, mfs_event, time_zero_date, imaging_disease_present),
    by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line", "time_zero_date")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    dat_combined %>%
      select(patient_id, all_of(c(death_date_cols, alive_cols))),
    by = "patient_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    death_date = if (length(death_date_cols) > 0) {
      as_date_safe(.data[[death_date_cols[1]]])
    } else {
      as.Date(NA)
    },
    alive_status = if (length(alive_cols) > 0) {
      case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[alive_cols[1]]])), "yes|y|1") ~ "Yes",
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[alive_cols[1]]])), "no|n|0") ~ "No",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },
    # Only include patients who survived to landmark (mfs_time >= landmark_time)
    survived_to_landmark = mfs_time >= landmark_time,
    # Survival time from landmark = mfs_time - landmark_time
    mfs_time_from_landmark = mfs_time - landmark_time,
    # Event status remains the same (if they had event, it's still an event)
    mfs_event_from_landmark = mfs_event,
    # Determine if imaging data is required (only for alive patients)
    imaging_required = case_when(
      !is.na(death_date) ~ FALSE,  # Dead patients don't need imaging
      alive_status == "No" ~ FALSE,  # Deceased patients don't need imaging
      alive_status == "Yes" ~ TRUE,  # Alive patients need imaging
      TRUE ~ TRUE  # Default: require imaging if status unknown
    )
  ) %>%
  # Filter: require valid survival time
  # For imaging: only exclude if patient is alive AND imaging is missing
  filter(survived_to_landmark, mfs_time_from_landmark > 0,
         !(imaging_required == TRUE & is.na(imaging_disease_present)))
  
# Track overall landmark events to enable fallback plotting if no post-landmark events by group
landmark_has_events <- sum(landmark_outcomes$mfs_event_from_landmark, na.rm = TRUE) > 0

cat("Landmark analysis: Early on-treatment ctDNA response\n")
cat("Landmark window: 6-16 weeks after therapy start\n")
cat("Response assessment: Uses LATEST ctDNA measurement available within 6-16 week window\n")
cat("Patients with on-treatment ctDNA in landmark window:", nrow(landmark_data), "\n")
cat("Patients who survived to their landmark time:", nrow(landmark_outcomes), "\n")
if (exists("landmark_outcomes") && nrow(landmark_outcomes) > 0) {
  cat("Landmark time distribution (weeks from therapy start):\n")
  cat("  Min:", round(min(landmark_outcomes$landmark_time, na.rm = TRUE) / 7, 1), 
      "Median:", round(median(landmark_outcomes$landmark_time, na.rm = TRUE) / 7, 1),
      "Max:", round(max(landmark_outcomes$landmark_time, na.rm = TRUE) / 7, 1), "\n")
  cat("MFS time distribution (days from therapy start):\n")
  cat("  Min:", round(min(landmark_outcomes$mfs_time, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      "Median:", round(median(landmark_outcomes$mfs_time, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      "Max:", round(max(landmark_outcomes$mfs_time, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "\n")
  cat("MFS time from landmark distribution (days):\n")
  cat("  Min:", round(min(landmark_outcomes$mfs_time_from_landmark, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      "Median:", round(median(landmark_outcomes$mfs_time_from_landmark, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      "Max:", round(max(landmark_outcomes$mfs_time_from_landmark, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "\n")
  cat("Total events after landmark:", sum(landmark_outcomes$mfs_event_from_landmark, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("Events before landmark (excluded):", sum(landmark_outcomes$mfs_time < landmark_outcomes$landmark_time, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
}
```

```{r immortal_time_bias_explanation}
# Explanation of how landmark analysis addresses immortal time bias
cat("## Addressing Immortal Time Bias\n\n")
cat("**Immortal time bias** occurs when patients must survive to a certain time to be classified into a group, artificially inflating survival. **Landmark analysis addresses this** by: (1) determining clearance status at the landmark time point (ctDNA measurement date within 6-16 weeks), not requiring survival to a later time; (2) analyzing survival FROM the landmark forward (time 0 = landmark time, not therapy start); and (3) including only patients who survived to landmark, ensuring equal opportunity for classification.\n\n")
```

```{r landmark_time_distribution_table}
# Show landmark time distribution by clearance status to demonstrate similar landmark times
if (exists("landmark_outcomes") && nrow(landmark_outcomes) > 0) {
  landmark_time_by_clearance <- landmark_outcomes %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark)) %>%
    mutate(landmark_time_weeks = landmark_time / 7) %>%
    group_by(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      median_landmark_weeks = round(median(landmark_time_weeks, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      iqr_lower = round(quantile(landmark_time_weeks, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      iqr_upper = round(quantile(landmark_time_weeks, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      clearance_status = ifelse(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark, "Cleared at Landmark", "Not Cleared at Landmark"),
      landmark_time_iqr = paste0(median_landmark_weeks, " (", iqr_lower, "-", iqr_upper, ")")
    ) %>%
    select(`Clearance Status` = clearance_status, `N` = n, `Landmark Time (weeks, median IQR)` = landmark_time_iqr)
  
  if (nrow(landmark_time_by_clearance) > 0) {
    landmark_time_by_clearance %>%
      kable(caption = "Landmark Time Distribution (weeks) by ctDNA Clearance Status (demonstrating similar landmark times across groups)") %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
  } else {
    cat("Insufficient data to create landmark time distribution table.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Landmark outcomes data not available.\n")
}
```

```{r landmark_analysis_results}
# Display landmark analysis results
if (exists("landmark_outcomes") && nrow(landmark_outcomes) > 0) {
  # Summary of response categories
  response_summary_table <- landmark_outcomes %>%
    count(response_category) %>%
    mutate(Percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>%
    rename(`Response Category` = response_category, `N` = n) %>%
    kable(caption = "Distribution of Early On-Treatment ctDNA Response (Landmark = ctDNA between 6-16 weeks after start)") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
  
  response_summary_table
  
  # Initialize variables
  hr_cleared <- hr_cleared_lower <- hr_cleared_upper <- p_cleared <- NA
  landmark_outcomes_cleared <- NULL
  landmark_results <- NULL
  
  # Create results table - unadjusted and adjusted models
  table_rows <- list()
  
  # Cox model: ctDNA Cleared at Landmark vs Not Cleared
  if (sum(!is.na(landmark_outcomes$ctdna_cleared_at_landmark)) > 10) {
    landmark_outcomes_cleared <- landmark_outcomes %>%
      filter(!is.na(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark)) %>%
      mutate(
        therapy_line_grouped = case_when(
          therapy_line == 1 ~ "1L",
          therapy_line == 2 ~ "2L",
          therapy_line == 3 ~ "3L",
          therapy_line >= 4 ~ "4L+",
          TRUE ~ as.character(therapy_line)
        ),
        therapy_line_factor = factor(therapy_line_grouped, levels = c("1L", "2L", "3L", "4L+"))
      )
    
    # Unadjusted Cox model (matches log-rank test from survival curve)
    cox_cleared_unadj <- tryCatch({
      coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark,
            data = landmark_outcomes_cleared)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    # Join therapy class if available
    if (exists("palliative_regimen_table") && nrow(palliative_regimen_table) > 0) {
      landmark_outcomes_cleared <- landmark_outcomes_cleared %>%
        left_join(
          palliative_regimen_table %>%
            mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(is.na(therapy_line_match), NA_integer_, therapy_line_match)) %>%
            select(patient_id, therapy_line_match, therapy_class) %>%
            distinct(),
          by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line" = "therapy_line_match")
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          therapy_class = replace_na(therapy_class, "unspecified"),
          therapy_class_factor = factor(therapy_class)
        )
    } else {
      landmark_outcomes_cleared <- landmark_outcomes_cleared %>%
        mutate(
          therapy_class = "unspecified",
          therapy_class_factor = factor("unspecified")
        )
    }
    
    # Join Bajorin risk factors if available
    if (exists("bajorin_data") && nrow(bajorin_data) > 0) {
      landmark_outcomes_cleared <- landmark_outcomes_cleared %>%
        left_join(
          bajorin_data %>% select(patient_id, therapy_line, kps_binary, visceral_mets_binary),
          by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line")
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          kps_factor = factor(kps_binary, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("KPS <80%", "KPS ≥80%")),
          visceral_mets_factor = factor(visceral_mets_binary, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No Visceral Mets", "Visceral Mets"))
        )
    } else {
      landmark_outcomes_cleared <- landmark_outcomes_cleared %>%
        mutate(
          kps_binary = NA_real_,
          visceral_mets_binary = NA_real_,
          kps_factor = factor(NA, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("KPS <80%", "KPS ≥80%")),
          visceral_mets_factor = factor(NA, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No Visceral Mets", "Visceral Mets"))
        )
    }
    
    # Adjusted Cox model (adjusted for line of therapy and therapy class)
    cox_cleared <- tryCatch({
      coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + therapy_line_factor + therapy_class_factor,
            data = landmark_outcomes_cleared)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    # Multivariate Cox model (adjusted for line of therapy + Bajorin risk factors)
    if (sum(!is.na(landmark_outcomes_cleared$kps_binary)) > 0 && 
        sum(!is.na(landmark_outcomes_cleared$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0) {
      landmark_outcomes_multiv <- landmark_outcomes_cleared %>%
        filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary))
      
      if (nrow(landmark_outcomes_multiv) > 0) {
        cox_cleared_multiv <- tryCatch({
          coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ 
                ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + therapy_line_factor + therapy_class_factor + kps_factor + visceral_mets_factor,
                data = landmark_outcomes_multiv)
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
      } else {
        cox_cleared_multiv <- NULL
      }
    } else {
      cox_cleared_multiv <- NULL
    }
    
    # Add unadjusted model for comparison (should match log-rank test) - FIRST
    if (!is.null(cox_cleared_unadj)) {
      model_converged_unadj <- tryCatch({
        isTRUE(cox_cleared_unadj$converged)
      }, error = function(e) FALSE)
      
      if (model_converged_unadj) {
        cox_cleared_unadj_summary <- summary(cox_cleared_unadj)
        hr_cleared_unadj <- cox_cleared_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
        hr_cleared_unadj_lower <- cox_cleared_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
        hr_cleared_unadj_upper <- cox_cleared_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
        p_cleared_unadj <- cox_cleared_unadj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
        
        # Check for reasonable HR values (not 0, Inf, or extremely large)
        if (!is.na(hr_cleared_unadj) && is.finite(hr_cleared_unadj) && hr_cleared_unadj > 0 && hr_cleared_unadj < 1e10 &&
            !is.na(hr_cleared_unadj_lower) && is.finite(hr_cleared_unadj_lower) &&
            !is.na(hr_cleared_unadj_upper) && is.finite(hr_cleared_unadj_upper)) {
          table_rows[[length(table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
            `Variable` = "ctDNA Cleared at Landmark vs Not Cleared (Unadjusted)",
            `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_cleared_unadj, 2), " (", round(hr_cleared_unadj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_cleared_unadj_upper, 2), ")"),
            `P-value` = ifelse(p_cleared_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_cleared_unadj, 3))),
            `N` = nrow(landmark_outcomes_cleared)
          )
        }
      }
    }
    
    if (!is.null(cox_cleared)) {
      model_converged_adj <- tryCatch({
        isTRUE(cox_cleared$converged)
      }, error = function(e) FALSE)
      
      if (model_converged_adj) {
        cox_cleared_summary <- summary(cox_cleared)
        hr_cleared <- cox_cleared_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
        hr_cleared_lower <- cox_cleared_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
        hr_cleared_upper <- cox_cleared_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
        p_cleared <- cox_cleared_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
        
        # Check for reasonable HR values
        if (!is.na(hr_cleared) && is.finite(hr_cleared) && hr_cleared > 0 && hr_cleared < 1e10 &&
            !is.na(hr_cleared_lower) && is.finite(hr_cleared_lower) &&
            !is.na(hr_cleared_upper) && is.finite(hr_cleared_upper)) {
          table_rows[[length(table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
            `Variable` = "ctDNA Cleared at Landmark vs Not Cleared (Adjusted for line of therapy and therapy class)",
            `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_cleared, 2), " (", round(hr_cleared_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_cleared_upper, 2), ")"),
            `P-value` = ifelse(p_cleared < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_cleared, 3))),
            `N` = nrow(landmark_outcomes_cleared)
          )
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Add multivariate model (adjusted for line of therapy + Bajorin risk factors) - LAST
    if (!is.null(cox_cleared_multiv)) {
      model_converged <- tryCatch({
        isTRUE(cox_cleared_multiv$converged)
      }, error = function(e) FALSE)
      
      if (model_converged) {
        cox_cleared_multiv_summary <- summary(cox_cleared_multiv)
        hr_cleared_multiv <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
        hr_cleared_multiv_lower <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
        hr_cleared_multiv_upper <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
        p_cleared_multiv <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
        
        # Check for reasonable HR values (not 0, Inf, or extremely large)
        if (!is.na(hr_cleared_multiv) && is.finite(hr_cleared_multiv) && hr_cleared_multiv > 0 && hr_cleared_multiv < 1e10 &&
            !is.na(hr_cleared_multiv_lower) && is.finite(hr_cleared_multiv_lower) &&
            !is.na(hr_cleared_multiv_upper) && is.finite(hr_cleared_multiv_upper)) {
          table_rows[[length(table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
            `Variable` = "ctDNA Cleared at Landmark vs Not Cleared (Adjusted for line of therapy, therapy class, KPS, and visceral metastases)",
            `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_cleared_multiv, 2), " (", round(hr_cleared_multiv_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_cleared_multiv_upper, 2), ")"),
            `P-value` = ifelse(p_cleared_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_cleared_multiv, 3))),
            `N` = nrow(landmark_outcomes_multiv)
          )
        } else {
          # Model converged but HR values are extreme - likely due to small sample size or separation
          cat("Note: Multivariate model converged but HR values are extreme (likely due to small sample size or complete separation). Model not included in results table.\n")
        }
      } else {
        cat("Note: Multivariate model did not converge (likely due to small sample size or too many covariates). Model not included in results table.\n")
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Create table if we have any valid models
  if (length(table_rows) > 0) {
    landmark_results <- bind_rows(table_rows) %>%
      kable(caption = "Landmark Analysis: Early On-Treatment ctDNA Response and Duration of Complete Response from Landmark (ctDNA between 6-16 weeks). Unadjusted model p-value should match log-rank test from survival curve; adjusted models account for line of therapy, therapy class (ADC, ICI, Chemo, Targeted, Other, and combinations), and Bajorin risk factors (KPS and visceral metastases).") %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
  } else {
    landmark_results <- NULL
  }
  
  # Create detailed multivariate results table for on-treatment analysis
  # Only create if model converged and has reasonable HR values
  if (!is.null(cox_cleared_multiv)) {
    model_converged <- tryCatch({
      isTRUE(cox_cleared_multiv$converged)
    }, error = function(e) FALSE)
    
    if (model_converged) {
      cox_cleared_multiv_summary <- summary(cox_cleared_multiv)
      n_coef <- nrow(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients)
      
      # Build results as list first
      multiv_landmark_results_list <- list()
      
      # Add ctDNA cleared coefficient
      if (n_coef > 0) {
        hr_val_cleared <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
        hr_lower_cleared <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
        hr_upper_cleared <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
        p_val_cleared <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
        
        # Only add if HR values are reasonable
        if (!is.na(hr_val_cleared) && is.finite(hr_val_cleared) && hr_val_cleared > 0 && hr_val_cleared < 1e10 &&
            !is.na(hr_lower_cleared) && is.finite(hr_lower_cleared) &&
            !is.na(hr_upper_cleared) && is.finite(hr_upper_cleared)) {
          multiv_landmark_results_list[[length(multiv_landmark_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
            `Variable` = "ctDNA Cleared at Landmark vs Not Cleared",
            `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
              round(hr_val_cleared, 2), " (",
              round(hr_lower_cleared, 2), "-",
              round(hr_upper_cleared, 2), ")"
            ),
            `P-value` = if (p_val_cleared < 0.001) "<0.001" else as.character(round(p_val_cleared, 3))
          )
        }
      }
      
      # Add therapy line coefficients (with convergence checks)
      therapy_line_idx <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients), "therapy_line_factor"))
      if (length(therapy_line_idx) > 0) {
        for (i in seq_along(therapy_line_idx)) {
          idx <- therapy_line_idx[i]
          if (idx <= nrow(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int) && i <= length(therapy_line_labels)) {
            hr_val_line <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "exp(coef)"]
            hr_lower_line <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "lower .95"]
            hr_upper_line <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "upper .95"]
            p_val_line <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"]
            
            # Only add if HR values are reasonable
            if (!is.na(hr_val_line) && is.finite(hr_val_line) && hr_val_line > 0 && hr_val_line < 1e10 &&
                !is.na(hr_lower_line) && is.finite(hr_lower_line) &&
                !is.na(hr_upper_line) && is.finite(hr_upper_line)) {
              multiv_landmark_results_list[[length(multiv_landmark_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
                `Variable` = therapy_line_labels[i],
                `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
                  round(hr_val_line, 2), " (",
                  round(hr_lower_line, 2), "-",
                  round(hr_upper_line, 2), ")"
                ),
                `P-value` = as.character(ifelse(p_val_line < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_val_line, 3)))
              )
            }
          }
        }
      }
      
      # Add KPS coefficient (with convergence checks)
      kps_idx <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients), "kps_factor"))
      if (length(kps_idx) > 0) {
        idx <- kps_idx[1]
        if (idx <= nrow(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int)) {
          hr_val_kps <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "exp(coef)"]
          hr_lower_kps <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "lower .95"]
          hr_upper_kps <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "upper .95"]
          p_val_kps <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"]
          
          # Only add if HR values are reasonable
          if (!is.na(hr_val_kps) && is.finite(hr_val_kps) && hr_val_kps > 0 && hr_val_kps < 1e10 &&
              !is.na(hr_lower_kps) && is.finite(hr_lower_kps) &&
              !is.na(hr_upper_kps) && is.finite(hr_upper_kps)) {
            multiv_landmark_results_list[[length(multiv_landmark_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
              `Variable` = "KPS ≥80% vs <80%",
              `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
                round(hr_val_kps, 2), " (",
                round(hr_lower_kps, 2), "-",
                round(hr_upper_kps, 2), ")"
              ),
              `P-value` = if (p_val_kps < 0.001) "<0.001" else as.character(round(p_val_kps, 3))
            )
          }
        }
      }
      
      # Add Visceral Metastases coefficient (with convergence checks)
      visceral_idx <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients), "visceral_mets_factor"))
      if (length(visceral_idx) > 0) {
        idx <- visceral_idx[1]
        if (idx <= nrow(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int)) {
          hr_val_visceral <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "exp(coef)"]
          hr_lower_visceral <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "lower .95"]
          hr_upper_visceral <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "upper .95"]
          p_val_visceral <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"]
          
          # Only add if HR values are reasonable
          if (!is.na(hr_val_visceral) && is.finite(hr_val_visceral) && hr_val_visceral > 0 && hr_val_visceral < 1e10 &&
              !is.na(hr_lower_visceral) && is.finite(hr_lower_visceral) &&
              !is.na(hr_upper_visceral) && is.finite(hr_upper_visceral)) {
            multiv_landmark_results_list[[length(multiv_landmark_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
              `Variable` = "Visceral Mets vs No Visceral Mets",
              `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
                round(hr_val_visceral, 2), " (",
                round(hr_lower_visceral, 2), "-",
                round(hr_upper_visceral, 2), ")"
              ),
              `P-value` = if (p_val_visceral < 0.001) "<0.001" else as.character(round(p_val_visceral, 3))
            )
          }
        }
      }
      
      # Add Therapy Class coefficients (with convergence checks)
      therapy_class_idx <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients), "therapy_class_factor"))
      if (length(therapy_class_idx) > 0) {
        for (i in seq_along(therapy_class_idx)) {
          idx <- therapy_class_idx[i]
          if (idx <= nrow(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int)) {
            term_name <- rownames(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients)[idx]
            class_name <- str_replace(term_name, "therapy_class_factor", "")
            p_val_class <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"]
            hr_val <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "exp(coef)"]
            ci_lower <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "lower .95"]
            ci_upper <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "upper .95"]
            
            # Only add if HR values are reasonable
            if (!is.na(hr_val) && is.finite(hr_val) && hr_val > 0 && hr_val < 1e10 &&
                !is.na(ci_lower) && is.finite(ci_lower) &&
                !is.na(ci_upper) && is.finite(ci_upper)) {
              p_val_text <- if (is.na(p_val_class)) {
                "NA"
              } else if (p_val_class < 0.001) {
                "<0.001"
              } else {
                as.character(round(p_val_class, 3))
              }
              
              multiv_landmark_results_list[[length(multiv_landmark_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
                `Variable` = paste0("Therapy Class: ", class_name, " vs reference"),
                `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
                  round(hr_val, 2), " (",
                  round(ci_lower, 2), "-",
                  round(ci_upper, 2), ")"
                ),
                `P-value` = p_val_text
              )
            }
          }
        }
      }
      
      # Combine all results - only create table if we have at least one row
      if (length(multiv_landmark_results_list) > 0) {
        multiv_landmark_results <- bind_rows(multiv_landmark_results_list)
        
        # Store for display
        landmark_multiv_table <- multiv_landmark_results %>%
          kable(caption = "Multivariate Cox Model: On-Treatment ctDNA Clearance and Duration of Complete Response from Landmark (adjusted for line of therapy, therapy class, KPS, and visceral metastases). Note: Only coefficients with reasonable HR values (converged models) are shown. Models with extreme HR values (0, Inf, or very large) are excluded due to convergence issues, likely due to small sample size or complete separation.") %>%
          kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
      } else {
        landmark_multiv_table <- NULL
      }
    } else {
      landmark_multiv_table <- NULL
    }
  } else {
    landmark_multiv_table <- NULL
  }
  
  # Ensure table variables are available for display chunks
  # (Tables will be displayed in separate chunks below)
} else {
  # If landmark_outcomes doesn't exist, set table to NULL
  landmark_multiv_table <- NULL
}
```

```{r landmark_multiv_table_display, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
# First, try to use the existing table
if (exists("landmark_multiv_table") && !is.null(landmark_multiv_table)) {
  # Display the table - kable objects render when referenced
  landmark_multiv_table
} else if (exists("cox_cleared_multiv") && !is.null(cox_cleared_multiv)) {
  # Try to recreate if it doesn't exist (fallback)
  if (exists("cox_cleared_multiv") && !is.null(cox_cleared_multiv)) {
    # Recreate the table using the same logic as landmark_analysis_results
    cox_cleared_multiv_summary <- summary(cox_cleared_multiv)
    n_coef <- nrow(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients)
    
    multiv_landmark_results_list <- list()
    
    # Add ctDNA cleared coefficient
    if (n_coef > 0) {
      p_val_cleared <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      multiv_landmark_results_list[[length(multiv_landmark_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Variable` = "ctDNA Cleared at Landmark vs Not Cleared",
        `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
          round(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"], 2), " (",
          round(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"], 2), "-",
          round(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"], 2), ")"
        ),
        `P-value` = if (p_val_cleared < 0.001) "<0.001" else as.character(round(p_val_cleared, 3))
      )
    }
    
    # Add therapy line coefficients
    if (exists("therapy_line_labels")) {
      therapy_line_idx <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients), "therapy_line_factor"))
      if (length(therapy_line_idx) > 0) {
        for (i in seq_along(therapy_line_idx)) {
          idx <- therapy_line_idx[i]
          if (idx <= nrow(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int) && i <= length(therapy_line_labels)) {
            p_val_line <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"]
            multiv_landmark_results_list[[length(multiv_landmark_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
              `Variable` = therapy_line_labels[i],
              `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
                round(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "exp(coef)"], 2), " (",
                round(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "lower .95"], 2), "-",
                round(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "upper .95"], 2), ")"
              ),
              `P-value` = as.character(ifelse(p_val_line < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_val_line, 3)))
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Add KPS coefficient
    kps_idx <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients), "kps_factor"))
    if (length(kps_idx) > 0) {
      idx <- kps_idx[1]
      if (idx <= nrow(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int)) {
        p_val_kps <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"]
        multiv_landmark_results_list[[length(multiv_landmark_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
          `Variable` = "KPS ≥80% vs <80%",
          `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
            round(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "exp(coef)"], 2), " (",
            round(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "lower .95"], 2), "-",
            round(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "upper .95"], 2), ")"
          ),
          `P-value` = if (p_val_kps < 0.001) "<0.001" else as.character(round(p_val_kps, 3))
        )
      }
    }
    
    # Add Visceral Metastases coefficient
    visceral_idx <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients), "visceral_mets_factor"))
    if (length(visceral_idx) > 0) {
      idx <- visceral_idx[1]
      if (idx <= nrow(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int)) {
        p_val_visceral <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"]
        multiv_landmark_results_list[[length(multiv_landmark_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
          `Variable` = "Visceral Mets vs No Visceral Mets",
          `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
            round(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "exp(coef)"], 2), " (",
            round(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "lower .95"], 2), "-",
            round(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "upper .95"], 2), ")"
          ),
          `P-value` = if (p_val_visceral < 0.001) "<0.001" else as.character(round(p_val_visceral, 3))
        )
      }
    }
    
    # Add Therapy Class coefficients
    therapy_class_idx <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients), "therapy_class_factor"))
    if (length(therapy_class_idx) > 0) {
      for (i in seq_along(therapy_class_idx)) {
        idx <- therapy_class_idx[i]
        if (idx <= nrow(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int)) {
          term_name <- rownames(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients)[idx]
          class_name <- str_replace(term_name, "therapy_class_factor", "")
          p_val_class <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"]
          hr_val <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "exp(coef)"]
          ci_lower <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "lower .95"]
          ci_upper <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "upper .95"]
          
          p_val_text <- if (is.na(p_val_class)) {
            "NA"
          } else if (p_val_class < 0.001) {
            "<0.001"
          } else {
            as.character(round(p_val_class, 3))
          }
          
          hr_ci_text <- if (is.na(hr_val) || is.na(ci_lower) || is.na(ci_upper)) {
            "NA (NA-NA)"
          } else {
            paste0(
              round(hr_val, 2), " (",
              round(ci_lower, 2), "-",
              round(ci_upper, 2), ")"
            )
          }
          
          multiv_landmark_results_list[[length(multiv_landmark_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
            `Variable` = paste0("Therapy Class: ", class_name, " vs reference"),
            `HR (95% CI)` = hr_ci_text,
            `P-value` = p_val_text
          )
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Create and display table if we have results
    if (length(multiv_landmark_results_list) > 0) {
      multiv_landmark_results <- bind_rows(multiv_landmark_results_list)
      
      landmark_multiv_table <- multiv_landmark_results %>%
        kable(caption = "Multivariate Cox Model: On-Treatment ctDNA Clearance and Duration of Complete Response from Landmark (adjusted for line of therapy, therapy class, KPS, and visceral metastases). Note: Only coefficients with reasonable HR values (converged models) are shown. Models with extreme HR values (0, Inf, or very large) are excluded due to convergence issues, likely due to small sample size or complete separation.") %>%
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
      
      # Display the table - kable objects render when referenced
      landmark_multiv_table
    } else {
      cat("\n\n**Note:** Multivariate model exists but no coefficients could be extracted for display.\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("\n\n**Multivariate Cox Model Status:**\n")
    cat("- Multivariate model with Bajorin risk factors for on-treatment analysis could not be fitted.\n")
    cat("- This may be due to missing KPS or visceral metastases data, or insufficient sample size.\n")
    cat("- Check that Bajorin risk factors data is available and that there are enough observations with complete data.\n")
  }
}

# Add sample size information in a separate output (after table)
if (exists("landmark_outcomes_multiv") && !is.null(landmark_outcomes_multiv) && 
    exists("landmark_multiv_table") && !is.null(landmark_multiv_table)) {
  cat("\n\n**N for multivariate on-treatment model:**", nrow(landmark_outcomes_multiv), "observations\n")
}
```

```{r continuous_ctdna_analyses, include=FALSE}
# ====================================================================================
# ADDITIONAL ANALYSES: Continuous ctDNA Variables for Research Question 2
# ====================================================================================
# These analyses complement the binary clearance analysis by examining continuous
# ctDNA measures: log-transformed on-treatment ctDNA and percent decline
# ====================================================================================

# Initialize variables for continuous analyses
cox_continuous_on_tx <- NULL
cox_pct_decline_continuous <- NULL
cox_interaction_baseline <- NULL
cox_combined_baseline_on_tx <- NULL
comprehensive_landmark_results <- NULL

# Add continuous variables to landmark_outcomes if not already present
if (exists("landmark_outcomes") && nrow(landmark_outcomes) > 0) {
  if (!"log_on_tx_ctdna" %in% names(landmark_outcomes)) {
    landmark_outcomes <- landmark_outcomes %>%
      mutate(
        log_on_tx_ctdna = log(on_tx_ctdna + 1),
        log_baseline_ctdna = log(baseline_ctdna + 1),
        baseline_high = log_baseline_ctdna > median(log_baseline_ctdna, na.rm = TRUE),
        baseline_high_factor = factor(baseline_high, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE), 
                                       labels = c("Low Baseline", "High Baseline"))
      )
  }
}

if (exists("landmark_outcomes") && nrow(landmark_outcomes) > 0 && 
    exists("landmark_outcomes_cleared") && !is.null(landmark_outcomes_cleared)) {
  
  # Add continuous variables to landmark_outcomes_cleared if not already present
  if (!"log_on_tx_ctdna" %in% names(landmark_outcomes_cleared)) {
    landmark_outcomes_cleared <- landmark_outcomes_cleared %>%
      mutate(
        log_on_tx_ctdna = log(on_tx_ctdna + 1),
        log_baseline_ctdna = log(baseline_ctdna + 1),
        baseline_high = log_baseline_ctdna > median(log_baseline_ctdna, na.rm = TRUE),
        baseline_high_factor = factor(baseline_high, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE), 
                                       labels = c("Low Baseline", "High Baseline"))
      )
  }
  
  # Prepare data with all necessary variables
  landmark_for_continuous <- landmark_outcomes_cleared %>%
    filter(!is.na(log_on_tx_ctdna), !is.na(pct_decline))
  
  # ANALYSIS 1: Continuous on-treatment ctDNA (log-transformed)
  if (nrow(landmark_for_continuous) > 10 && 
      sum(!is.na(landmark_for_continuous$kps_binary)) > 0 && 
      sum(!is.na(landmark_for_continuous$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0) {
    
    landmark_continuous_multiv <- landmark_for_continuous %>%
      filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary))
    
    if (nrow(landmark_continuous_multiv) > 0) {
      cox_continuous_on_tx <- tryCatch({
        coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ 
              log_on_tx_ctdna + therapy_line_factor + therapy_class_factor + 
              kps_factor + visceral_mets_factor,
              data = landmark_continuous_multiv)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
    }
  }
  
  # ANALYSIS 2: Percent decline as continuous variable
  if (nrow(landmark_for_continuous) > 10 && 
      sum(!is.na(landmark_for_continuous$kps_binary)) > 0 && 
      sum(!is.na(landmark_for_continuous$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0) {
    
    landmark_pct_multiv <- landmark_for_continuous %>%
      filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary), 
             !is.infinite(pct_decline), !is.na(pct_decline))
    
    if (nrow(landmark_pct_multiv) > 0) {
      cox_pct_decline_continuous <- tryCatch({
        coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ 
              pct_decline + therapy_line_factor + therapy_class_factor + 
              kps_factor + visceral_mets_factor,
              data = landmark_pct_multiv)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
    }
  }
  
  # ANALYSIS 3: Interaction between baseline and on-treatment ctDNA
  if (nrow(landmark_for_continuous) > 10 && 
      sum(!is.na(landmark_for_continuous$kps_binary)) > 0 && 
      sum(!is.na(landmark_for_continuous$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0 &&
      sum(!is.na(landmark_for_continuous$baseline_high_factor)) > 0) {
    
    landmark_interaction_multiv <- landmark_for_continuous %>%
      filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary),
             !is.na(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark), !is.na(baseline_high_factor))
    
    if (nrow(landmark_interaction_multiv) > 0) {
      cox_interaction_baseline <- tryCatch({
        coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ 
              ctdna_cleared_at_landmark * baseline_high_factor + 
              therapy_line_factor + therapy_class_factor + 
              kps_factor + visceral_mets_factor,
              data = landmark_interaction_multiv)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
    }
  }
  
  # ANALYSIS 4: Combined model (baseline + on-treatment)
  if (nrow(landmark_for_continuous) > 10 && 
      sum(!is.na(landmark_for_continuous$kps_binary)) > 0 && 
      sum(!is.na(landmark_for_continuous$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0) {
    
    landmark_combined_multiv <- landmark_for_continuous %>%
      filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary),
             !is.na(log_baseline_ctdna), !is.na(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark))
    
    if (nrow(landmark_combined_multiv) > 0) {
      cox_combined_baseline_on_tx <- tryCatch({
        coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ 
              log_baseline_ctdna + ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + 
              therapy_line_factor + therapy_class_factor + 
              kps_factor + visceral_mets_factor,
              data = landmark_combined_multiv)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
    }
  }
  
  # Create comprehensive results table
  results_list_continuous <- list()
  
  # Binary clearance (from existing analysis) - only if converged and reasonable HR
  if (exists("cox_cleared_multiv") && !is.null(cox_cleared_multiv)) {
    model_converged <- tryCatch({
      isTRUE(cox_cleared_multiv$converged)
    }, error = function(e) FALSE)
    
    if (model_converged) {
      cox_cleared_multiv_summary <- summary(cox_cleared_multiv)
      hr_val <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
      hr_lower <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
      hr_upper <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
      
      if (!is.na(hr_val) && is.finite(hr_val) && hr_val > 0 && hr_val < 1e10 &&
          !is.na(hr_lower) && is.finite(hr_lower) &&
          !is.na(hr_upper) && is.finite(hr_upper)) {
        results_list_continuous[[length(results_list_continuous) + 1]] <- tibble(
          `Model` = "Binary: Cleared vs Not Cleared",
          `Variable` = "ctDNA Cleared at Landmark",
          `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
            round(hr_val, 2), " (",
            round(hr_lower, 2), "-",
            round(hr_upper, 2), ")"
          ),
          `P-value` = ifelse(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"] < 0.001, 
                             "<0.001", 
                             as.character(round(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"], 3))),
          `N` = cox_cleared_multiv$n
        )
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Continuous on-treatment ctDNA - only if converged and reasonable HR
  if (!is.null(cox_continuous_on_tx)) {
    model_converged <- tryCatch({
      isTRUE(cox_continuous_on_tx$converged)
    }, error = function(e) FALSE)
    
    if (model_converged) {
      cox_cont_summary <- summary(cox_continuous_on_tx)
      hr_val <- cox_cont_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
      hr_lower <- cox_cont_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
      hr_upper <- cox_cont_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
      
      if (!is.na(hr_val) && is.finite(hr_val) && hr_val > 0 && hr_val < 1e10 &&
          !is.na(hr_lower) && is.finite(hr_lower) &&
          !is.na(hr_upper) && is.finite(hr_upper)) {
        results_list_continuous[[length(results_list_continuous) + 1]] <- tibble(
          `Model` = "Continuous: Log(On-treatment ctDNA + 1)",
          `Variable` = "Per log-unit increase in on-treatment ctDNA",
          `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
            round(hr_val, 2), " (",
            round(hr_lower, 2), "-",
            round(hr_upper, 2), ")"
          ),
          `P-value` = ifelse(cox_cont_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"] < 0.001, 
                             "<0.001", 
                             as.character(round(cox_cont_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"], 3))),
          `N` = cox_continuous_on_tx$n
        )
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Percent decline (per 10% unit for interpretability) - only if converged and reasonable HR
  if (!is.null(cox_pct_decline_continuous)) {
    model_converged <- tryCatch({
      isTRUE(cox_pct_decline_continuous$converged)
    }, error = function(e) FALSE)
    
    if (model_converged) {
      cox_pct_summary <- summary(cox_pct_decline_continuous)
      # HR per 10% increase in decline
      hr_per_10pct <- exp(cox_pct_summary$coefficients[1, "coef"] * 10)
      ci_lower_per_10pct <- exp((cox_pct_summary$coefficients[1, "coef"] - 
                                 1.96 * cox_pct_summary$coefficients[1, "se(coef)"]) * 10)
      ci_upper_per_10pct <- exp((cox_pct_summary$coefficients[1, "coef"] + 
                                 1.96 * cox_pct_summary$coefficients[1, "se(coef)"]) * 10)
      
      if (!is.na(hr_per_10pct) && is.finite(hr_per_10pct) && hr_per_10pct > 0 && hr_per_10pct < 1e10 &&
          !is.na(ci_lower_per_10pct) && is.finite(ci_lower_per_10pct) &&
          !is.na(ci_upper_per_10pct) && is.finite(ci_upper_per_10pct)) {
        results_list_continuous[[length(results_list_continuous) + 1]] <- tibble(
          `Model` = "Continuous: Percent Decline from Baseline",
          `Variable` = "Per 10% increase in decline",
          `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
            round(hr_per_10pct, 2), " (",
            round(ci_lower_per_10pct, 2), "-",
            round(ci_upper_per_10pct, 2), ")"
          ),
          `P-value` = ifelse(cox_pct_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"] < 0.001, 
                             "<0.001", 
                             as.character(round(cox_pct_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"], 3))),
          `N` = cox_pct_decline_continuous$n
        )
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Combined model (baseline + on-treatment) - only if converged and reasonable HR
  if (!is.null(cox_combined_baseline_on_tx)) {
    model_converged <- tryCatch({
      isTRUE(cox_combined_baseline_on_tx$converged)
    }, error = function(e) FALSE)
    
    if (model_converged) {
      cox_comb_summary <- summary(cox_combined_baseline_on_tx)
      
      # Baseline ctDNA
      hr_baseline <- cox_comb_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
      hr_baseline_lower <- cox_comb_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
      hr_baseline_upper <- cox_comb_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
      
      if (!is.na(hr_baseline) && is.finite(hr_baseline) && hr_baseline > 0 && hr_baseline < 1e10 &&
          !is.na(hr_baseline_lower) && is.finite(hr_baseline_lower) &&
          !is.na(hr_baseline_upper) && is.finite(hr_baseline_upper)) {
        results_list_continuous[[length(results_list_continuous) + 1]] <- tibble(
          `Model` = "Combined: Baseline + On-treatment",
          `Variable` = "Baseline ctDNA (per log-unit)",
          `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
            round(hr_baseline, 2), " (",
            round(hr_baseline_lower, 2), "-",
            round(hr_baseline_upper, 2), ")"
          ),
          `P-value` = ifelse(cox_comb_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"] < 0.001, 
                             "<0.001", 
                             as.character(round(cox_comb_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"], 3))),
          `N` = cox_combined_baseline_on_tx$n
        )
      }
      
      # On-treatment clearance
      if (nrow(cox_comb_summary$conf.int) >= 2) {
        hr_ontx <- cox_comb_summary$conf.int[2, "exp(coef)"]
        hr_ontx_lower <- cox_comb_summary$conf.int[2, "lower .95"]
        hr_ontx_upper <- cox_comb_summary$conf.int[2, "upper .95"]
        
        if (!is.na(hr_ontx) && is.finite(hr_ontx) && hr_ontx > 0 && hr_ontx < 1e10 &&
            !is.na(hr_ontx_lower) && is.finite(hr_ontx_lower) &&
            !is.na(hr_ontx_upper) && is.finite(hr_ontx_upper)) {
          results_list_continuous[[length(results_list_continuous) + 1]] <- tibble(
            `Model` = "Combined: Baseline + On-treatment",
            `Variable` = "On-treatment ctDNA Cleared",
            `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
              round(hr_ontx, 2), " (",
              round(hr_ontx_lower, 2), "-",
              round(hr_ontx_upper, 2), ")"
            ),
            `P-value` = ifelse(cox_comb_summary$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|z|)"] < 0.001, 
                               "<0.001", 
                               as.character(round(cox_comb_summary$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|z|)"], 3))),
            `N` = cox_combined_baseline_on_tx$n
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Combine all results
  if (length(results_list_continuous) > 0) {
    comprehensive_landmark_results <- bind_rows(results_list_continuous)
  }
}

cat("Continuous ctDNA analyses completed.\n")
```

```{r baseline_vs_landmark_population_comparison, echo=FALSE}
# Compare baseline and on-treatment populations

    summarise(
      `Analysis` = "Baseline ctDNA (Research Question 1)",

  population_comparison <- bind_rows(baseline_summary, landmark_summary) %>%

  population_comparison
} else {
  cat("Population comparison not available.\n")
}
```

```{r landmark_interpretation}
# Interpretation of Hazard Ratios (always show if we have results)
# Use multivariate HR (adjusted for line of therapy + KPS + visceral metastases)
if (exists("landmark_results") && !is.null(landmark_results)) {
  cat("\n**Interpretation of Hazard Ratios (adjusted for line of therapy, KPS, and visceral metastases):**\n\n")
  
  # Prefer multivariate HR if available, otherwise fall back to adjusted HR
  if (exists("hr_cleared_multiv") && !is.na(hr_cleared_multiv)) {
    hr_to_use <- hr_cleared_multiv
    hr_lower_to_use <- hr_cleared_multiv_lower
    hr_upper_to_use <- hr_cleared_multiv_upper
    p_to_use <- p_cleared_multiv
    adjustment_note <- " (adjusted for line of therapy, KPS, and visceral metastases)"
  } else if (exists("hr_cleared") && !is.na(hr_cleared)) {
    hr_to_use <- hr_cleared
    hr_lower_to_use <- hr_cleared_lower
    hr_upper_to_use <- hr_cleared_upper
    p_to_use <- p_cleared
    adjustment_note <- " (adjusted for line of therapy)"
  } else {
    hr_to_use <- NA
  }
  
  if (!is.na(hr_to_use)) {
    if (hr_to_use < 1) {
      cat("- **ctDNA Cleared at Landmark vs Not Cleared (HR = ", round(hr_to_use, 2), ", 95% CI: ", 
          round(hr_lower_to_use, 2), "-", round(hr_upper_to_use, 2), ", p = ", 
          ifelse(p_to_use < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_to_use, 3)), ")", adjustment_note, ":** Patients who cleared ctDNA at the landmark time point (6-16 weeks after therapy initiation) had a ", 
          round((1 - hr_to_use) * 100, 1), "% lower risk of metastasis or death COMPARED to those who did not clear ctDNA at the landmark. ", sep = "")
    } else {
      cat("- **ctDNA Cleared at Landmark vs Not Cleared (HR = ", round(hr_to_use, 2), ", 95% CI: ", 
          round(hr_lower_to_use, 2), "-", round(hr_upper_to_use, 2), ", p = ", 
          ifelse(p_to_use < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_to_use, 3)), ")", adjustment_note, ":** Patients who cleared ctDNA at the landmark time point (6-16 weeks after therapy initiation) had a ", 
          round((hr_to_use - 1) * 100, 1), "% higher risk of metastasis or death COMPARED to those who did not clear ctDNA at the landmark. ", sep = "")
    }
    cat("This suggests that early ctDNA clearance may serve as a pharmacodynamic response biomarker, indicating effective treatment and potentially predicting improved metastasis-free survival.\n\n")
  }
}
```
