```{r landmark_survival_curves}
# Survival curves: ctDNA Cleared at Landmark vs Not Cleared
if (exists("landmark_outcomes") && nrow(landmark_outcomes) > 0) {
  if (exists("landmark_outcomes_cleared") && 
      sum(landmark_outcomes_cleared$ctdna_cleared_at_landmark, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 && 
      sum(!landmark_outcomes_cleared$ctdna_cleared_at_landmark, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
    landmark_outcomes_cleared <- landmark_outcomes_cleared %>%
      mutate(
        cleared_label = ifelse(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark, "Cleared at Landmark", "Not Cleared at Landmark"),
        # Convert time to months for plotting
        mfs_time_from_landmark_months = mfs_time_from_landmark / 30.44
      )
    
    # Diagnostic: Check event counts
    cat("\n**Landmark Analysis Diagnostic:**\n")
    cat("Total patients in cleared analysis:", nrow(landmark_outcomes_cleared), "\n")
    cat("Events in Cleared group:", sum(landmark_outcomes_cleared$ctdna_cleared_at_landmark & landmark_outcomes_cleared$mfs_event_from_landmark == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
    cat("Events in Not Cleared group:", sum(!landmark_outcomes_cleared$ctdna_cleared_at_landmark & landmark_outcomes_cleared$mfs_event_from_landmark == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
    cat("Total events:", sum(landmark_outcomes_cleared$mfs_event_from_landmark, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
    cat("Median survival time from landmark (months):", round(median(landmark_outcomes_cleared$mfs_time_from_landmark_months, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "\n")
    
    surv_fit_cleared <- survfit(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark_months, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ cleared_label, 
                                  data = landmark_outcomes_cleared)
    
    # Get adjusted p-value from Cox model (prefer multivariate: adjusted for line of therapy + KPS + visceral metastases)
    # Use multivariate p-value if available, otherwise fall back to line of therapy only
    if (exists("p_cleared_multiv") && !is.na(p_cleared_multiv)) {
      # Use multivariate p-value (adjusted for line of therapy + KPS + visceral metastases)
      pval_text <- ifelse(p_cleared_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_cleared_multiv, 3))
      pval_numeric <- p_cleared_multiv
      cat("Using adjusted p-value from Cox model (adjusted for line of therapy, KPS, and visceral metastases):", pval_text, "\n\n")
    } else if (exists("p_cleared") && !is.na(p_cleared)) {
      # Fall back to p-value adjusted for line of therapy only
      pval_text <- ifelse(p_cleared < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_cleared, 3))
      pval_numeric <- p_cleared
      cat("Using adjusted p-value from Cox model (adjusted for line of therapy):", pval_text, "\n\n")
    } else {
      # Recalculate if not already available
      landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox <- landmark_outcomes %>%
        filter(!is.na(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark)) %>%
        mutate(
          therapy_line_grouped = case_when(
            therapy_line == 1 ~ "1L",
            therapy_line == 2 ~ "2L",
            therapy_line == 3 ~ "3L",
            therapy_line >= 4 ~ "4L+",
            TRUE ~ as.character(therapy_line)
          ),
          therapy_line_factor = factor(therapy_line_grouped, levels = c("1L", "2L", "3L", "4L+"))
        )
      
      # Add therapy class if available
      if (exists("palliative_regimen_table") && nrow(palliative_regimen_table) > 0) {
        landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox <- landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox %>%
          left_join(
            palliative_regimen_table %>%
              mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(is.na(therapy_line_match), NA_integer_, therapy_line_match)) %>%
              select(patient_id, therapy_line_match, therapy_class) %>%
              distinct(),
            by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line" = "therapy_line_match")
          ) %>%
          mutate(
            therapy_class = replace_na(therapy_class, "unspecified"),
            therapy_class_factor = factor(therapy_class)
          )
      } else {
        landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox <- landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox %>%
          mutate(
            therapy_class = "unspecified",
            therapy_class_factor = factor("unspecified")
          )
      }
      
      # Try multivariate model first if Bajorin data is available
      if (exists("bajorin_data") && nrow(bajorin_data) > 0) {
        landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox <- landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox %>%
          left_join(
            bajorin_data %>% select(patient_id, therapy_line, kps_binary, visceral_mets_binary),
            by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line")
          ) %>%
          filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary)) %>%
          mutate(
            kps_factor = factor(kps_binary, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("KPS <80%", "KPS ≥80%")),
            visceral_mets_factor = factor(visceral_mets_binary, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No Visceral Mets", "Visceral Mets"))
          )
        
        if (nrow(landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox) > 0) {
          cox_cleared_multiv_adj <- tryCatch({
            coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ 
                  ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + therapy_line_factor + therapy_class_factor + kps_factor + visceral_mets_factor,
                  data = landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox)
          }, error = function(e) NULL)
          
          if (!is.null(cox_cleared_multiv_adj)) {
            cox_cleared_multiv_adj_summary <- summary(cox_cleared_multiv_adj)
            p_cleared_multiv <- cox_cleared_multiv_adj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
            pval_text <- ifelse(p_cleared_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_cleared_multiv, 3))
            pval_numeric <- p_cleared_multiv
            cat("Using adjusted p-value from Cox model (adjusted for line of therapy, therapy class, KPS, and visceral metastases):", pval_text, "\n\n")
          } else {
            # Fall back to line of therapy only
            landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox <- landmark_outcomes %>%
              filter(!is.na(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark)) %>%
              mutate(
                therapy_line_grouped = case_when(
                  therapy_line == 1 ~ "1L",
                  therapy_line == 2 ~ "2L",
                  therapy_line == 3 ~ "3L",
                  therapy_line >= 4 ~ "4L+",
                  TRUE ~ as.character(therapy_line)
                ),
                therapy_line_factor = factor(therapy_line_grouped, levels = c("1L", "2L", "3L", "4L+"))
              )
            
            # Add therapy class if available
            if (exists("palliative_regimen_table") && nrow(palliative_regimen_table) > 0) {
              landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox <- landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox %>%
                left_join(
                  palliative_regimen_table %>%
                    mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(is.na(therapy_line_match), NA_integer_, therapy_line_match)) %>%
                    select(patient_id, therapy_line_match, therapy_class) %>%
                    distinct(),
                  by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line" = "therapy_line_match")
                ) %>%
                mutate(
                  therapy_class = replace_na(therapy_class, "unspecified"),
                  therapy_class_factor = factor(therapy_class)
                )
            } else {
              landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox <- landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox %>%
                mutate(
                  therapy_class = "unspecified",
                  therapy_class_factor = factor("unspecified")
                )
            }
            
            cox_cleared_adj <- tryCatch({
              coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + therapy_line_factor + therapy_class_factor,
                    data = landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox)
            }, error = function(e) NULL)
            
            if (!is.null(cox_cleared_adj)) {
              cox_cleared_adj_summary <- summary(cox_cleared_adj)
              p_cleared <- cox_cleared_adj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
              pval_text <- ifelse(p_cleared < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_cleared, 3))
              pval_numeric <- p_cleared
              cat("Using adjusted p-value from Cox model (adjusted for line of therapy and therapy class):", pval_text, "\n\n")
            } else {
              # Fallback to log-rank test
              logrank_test <- survdiff(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark_months, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ cleared_label, 
                                       data = landmark_outcomes_cleared)
              logrank_pvalue <- 1 - pchisq(logrank_test$chisq, length(logrank_test$n) - 1)
              pval_text <- ifelse(logrank_pvalue < 0.001, "<0.001", round(logrank_pvalue, 3))
              pval_numeric <- logrank_pvalue
              cat("Using log-rank test p-value (unadjusted) - adjusted p-value not available.\n\n")
            }
          }
        } else {
          # Not enough data for multivariate, try line of therapy only
          landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox <- landmark_outcomes %>%
            filter(!is.na(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark)) %>%
            mutate(
              therapy_line_grouped = case_when(
                therapy_line == 1 ~ "1L",
                therapy_line == 2 ~ "2L",
                therapy_line == 3 ~ "3L",
                therapy_line >= 4 ~ "4L+",
                TRUE ~ as.character(therapy_line)
              ),
              therapy_line_factor = factor(therapy_line_grouped, levels = c("1L", "2L", "3L", "4L+"))
            )
          
          # Add therapy class if available
          if (exists("palliative_regimen_table") && nrow(palliative_regimen_table) > 0) {
            landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox <- landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox %>%
              left_join(
                palliative_regimen_table %>%
                  mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(is.na(therapy_line_match), NA_integer_, therapy_line_match)) %>%
                  select(patient_id, therapy_line_match, therapy_class) %>%
                  distinct(),
                by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line" = "therapy_line_match")
              ) %>%
              mutate(
                therapy_class = replace_na(therapy_class, "unspecified"),
                therapy_class_factor = factor(therapy_class)
              )
          } else {
            landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox <- landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox %>%
              mutate(
                therapy_class = "unspecified",
                therapy_class_factor = factor("unspecified")
              )
          }
          
          cox_cleared_adj <- tryCatch({
            coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + therapy_line_factor + therapy_class_factor,
                  data = landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox)
          }, error = function(e) NULL)
          
          if (!is.null(cox_cleared_adj)) {
            cox_cleared_adj_summary <- summary(cox_cleared_adj)
            p_cleared <- cox_cleared_adj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
            pval_text <- ifelse(p_cleared < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_cleared, 3))
            pval_numeric <- p_cleared
            cat("Using adjusted p-value from Cox model (adjusted for line of therapy):", pval_text, "\n\n")
          } else {
            # Fallback to log-rank test
            logrank_test <- survdiff(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark_months, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ cleared_label, 
                                     data = landmark_outcomes_cleared)
            logrank_pvalue <- 1 - pchisq(logrank_test$chisq, length(logrank_test$n) - 1)
            pval_text <- ifelse(logrank_pvalue < 0.001, "<0.001", round(logrank_pvalue, 3))
            pval_numeric <- logrank_pvalue
            cat("Using log-rank test p-value (unadjusted) - adjusted p-value not available.\n\n")
          }
        }
      } else {
        # No Bajorin data, try line of therapy only
        cox_cleared_adj <- tryCatch({
          coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + therapy_line_factor + therapy_class_factor,
                data = landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox)
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        
        if (!is.null(cox_cleared_adj)) {
          cox_cleared_adj_summary <- summary(cox_cleared_adj)
          p_cleared <- cox_cleared_adj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
          pval_text <- ifelse(p_cleared < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_cleared, 3))
          pval_numeric <- p_cleared
          cat("Using adjusted p-value from Cox model (adjusted for line of therapy):", pval_text, "\n\n")
        } else {
          # Fallback to log-rank test
          logrank_test <- survdiff(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark_months, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ cleared_label, 
                                   data = landmark_outcomes_cleared)
          logrank_pvalue <- 1 - pchisq(logrank_test$chisq, length(logrank_test$n) - 1)
          pval_text <- ifelse(logrank_pvalue < 0.001, "<0.001", round(logrank_pvalue, 3))
          pval_numeric <- logrank_pvalue
          cat("Using log-rank test p-value (unadjusted) - adjusted p-value not available.\n\n")
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Create custom p-value text
    # Check if we used multivariate p-value
    if (exists("p_cleared_multiv") && !is.na(p_cleared_multiv) && pval_numeric == p_cleared_multiv) {
      pval_display <- paste0("p = ", pval_text, " (adjusted for line of therapy, KPS, and visceral metastases)")
    } else if (!is.null(p_cleared) && !is.na(p_cleared) && pval_numeric == p_cleared) {
      pval_display <- paste0("p = ", pval_text, " (adjusted for line of therapy)")
    } else {
      pval_display <- paste0("p = ", pval_text)
    }
    
    p_landmark <- ggsurvplot(
      surv_fit_cleared,
      data = landmark_outcomes_cleared,
      pval = pval_display,
      pval.size = 4,
      conf.int = TRUE,
      risk.table = TRUE,
      xlab = "Time from Landmark (months)",
      ylab = "Duration of Complete Response Probability",
      title = "Duration of Complete Response from Landmark (ctDNA between 6-16 weeks) by ctDNA Clearance Status at Landmark",
      xlim = c(0, 12),
      legend.title = "ctDNA Status at Landmark",
      legend.labs = c("Cleared at Landmark", "Not Cleared at Landmark")
    )
    
    p_landmark$plot
  } else {
    # Fallback: overall landmark curve (ignoring clearance) to show any events
    if (exists("landmark_outcomes") && nrow(landmark_outcomes) > 0) {
      landmark_outcomes_overall <- landmark_outcomes %>%
        mutate(mfs_time_from_landmark_months = mfs_time_from_landmark / 30.44)
      
      # Diagnostic: Check event counts for overall
      cat("\n**Landmark Analysis Diagnostic (Overall Fallback):**\n")
      cat("Total patients:", nrow(landmark_outcomes_overall), "\n")
      cat("Total events:", sum(landmark_outcomes_overall$mfs_event_from_landmark, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
      cat("Median time from landmark (months):", round(median(landmark_outcomes_overall$mfs_time_from_landmark_months, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "\n")
      
      surv_fit_overall <- survfit(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark_months, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ 1, 
                                   data = landmark_outcomes_overall)
      p_landmark_overall <- ggsurvplot(
        surv_fit_overall,
        data = landmark_outcomes_overall,
        pval = FALSE,
        conf.int = TRUE,
        risk.table = TRUE,
        xlab = "Time from Landmark (months)",
        ylab = "Duration of Complete Response Probability",
        title = "Duration of Complete Response from Landmark (ctDNA between 6-16 weeks) - Overall",
        xlim = c(0, 36)
      )
      p_landmark_overall$plot
      if (sum(landmark_outcomes_overall$mfs_event_from_landmark, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
        cat("Note: No post-landmark events; overall curve shown.\n")
      } else if (sum(!is.na(landmark_outcomes$ctdna_cleared_at_landmark)) <= 10) {
        cat("Note: Only one ctDNA clearance group available or <10 with clearance data; overall curve shown.\n")
      }
    } else {
      cat("Insufficient data for landmark analysis (need at least 10 patients with clearance data).\n")
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("No patients with on-treatment ctDNA measurements in landmark window (", landmark_weeks, " weeks, window: 10-14 weeks).\n", sep = "")
}
```
